property_summary: SetMinSum can only succeed before initialization, so after calling Initialized() any attempt to SetMinSum(uint) will revert.
If SetMinSum succeeds (does not revert) when called after a Collect from the same caller, then the contract must already be initialized; otherwise SetMinSum will revert.
Once Initialized() has been called, MinSum cannot change (SetMinSum must revert or leave MinSum unchanged).

property_summary: After calling SetMinSum(x) the publicly readable MinSum of c equals x (i.e. SetMinSum does not revert and sets MinSum).
Calling SetMinSum with a value sets MinSum equal to that value (not increased by it) when called once before initialization.
Calling SetMinSum(x) when contract is not yet initialized sets MinSum to x (i.e., MinSum equals the passed argument).
Calling SetMinSum with a value when the contract is uninitialized makes MinSum equal to the provided value (i.e., MinSum after the call is exactly the argument).

property_summary: For any sequence of external calls where caller's balance and unlockTime allow Collect to send funds, calling Collect must never change MinSum; the mutant that uses '+=' for SetMinSum can make MinSum differ after Collect when MinSum was set via SetMinSum fuzzed values.

For any inputs used to initialize MinSum and then call Collect, calling Collect must NOT change the stored MinSum; the mutant that uses '+=' in SetMinSum can cause MinSum to change after Collect for some fuzzed input sequence (by relying on a failing external call path that makes Collect revert the transfer but still allows state differences), so the property asserts MinSum remains equal to the initially read value after Collect.

For any fuzzed MinSum value and a depositor/collector scenario, calling Collect must not change the stored MinSum; the mutant that uses '+=' in SetMinSum can make MinSum differ after Collect for some inputs (the test detects that).

For any admissible inputs, calling Collect(...) does not change the contract's MinSum value (reference preserves MinSum across Collect), but the mutant that uses '+=' in SetMinSum can cause MinSum to change for some fuzzed inputs when Collect triggers a failing external send.
